integrity: The arbitrary-order statement follows from an explicit exhaustive case partition. Independent finite brute-force replay checks the literal definition for every parameter pair \(2\le r,n\le4\); finite computation is used only as a boundary and transcription check.
limitations: The theorem treats the classical two-color model on complete split graphs with both parts of size at least two. It does not classify higher-color rainbow domination or arbitrary split graphs, and literature indexing cannot rule out every inaccessible equivalent formula.
title: 2-rainbow domination polynomial of complete split graphs
